newsitem.title: KUWAIT: Kuwait MP to U.S. after assassination attempt.
newsitem.headline: Kuwait MP to U.S. after assassination attempt.

text.p: A leading Kuwaiti opposition parliamentarian who survived an assassination attempt will fly to the United States on Sunday for further medical care, his brother said on Saturday.

Abdullah al-Naibari's condition allows him to make the trip nine days after he was hit in the jaw and left shoulder when gunmen opened fire on his car with assault rifles, his younger brother sea captain Abdul-Rahman al-Naibari said.
"We will fly to Boston on Sunday aboard a private Emiri aircraft," he said. "Abdullah is talking well but he is unable to move his left arm as easily as before".
Three Kuwaitis and two Iranians have been arrested in conncetion with the attempt to assassinate Oxford-educated Naibari, a 61-year-old liberal critic of the government.
Emir Sheikh Jaber al-Ahmad al-Sabah, who had visited Naibari in hospital last Saturday, ordered that he be sent abroad for further treatment.
"Abdullah will conduct further tests and rest" in the United States, said the younger Naibari.
